# ViDi Microfiber Hair Towel Wraps with Bonus Wide Tooth Comb (2-Pack)

Get your day started sooner. ViDi Microfiber Hair Towel Wraps help your hair dry faster, so you have more time for makeup, your morning coffee, or a relaxing routine.

## Dry Hair Faster with UltraWicking Technology

The UltraWicking microfiber is designed to absorb up to 80 percent more water than standard towels, which can shorten your drying time after a shower. Wrap your wet hair and let the towel work while you get ready.

## A Secure Fit Without the Fuss

Loop the button over the wrap to keep it in place as you move through your morning. The wrap is simple to put on, comfortable to wear, and stays put so you can focus on what's next.

## Detangle Damp Hair with Ease

The included wide-tooth comb glides through damp hair to loosen knots and tangles, making styling smoother from start to finish.

## Made for Every Hair Length

The wraps are roomy enough for long, thick hair and sized for shorter styles and young girls alike. The soft, thick fabric feels like a cozy wrap, and the pink and white two-pack means a fresh one is always ready.

Add ViDi Hair Towel Wraps to your cart today and make wet hair time work for you.
